name: www.bamsoftware.com/git/dnstt.git/dns
reason: MessageFromWireFormat decodes the header, questions and record owner names, but every record keeps its RDATA as raw bytes (RR.Data) and the package exports no decoder for names inside RDATA (only DecodeRDataTXT). The control's compressed CNAME and MX targets could only be produced by the harness parsing RDATA itself, so the observed result would not come from the library.

name: github.com/cybergarage/go-mdns/mdns/dns
reason: The mDNS message parser has typed records only for PTR, SRV, TXT, A, AAAA and NSEC (mdns/dns/record_impl.go); CNAME and MX RDATA are left as untyped bytes, so the control's CNAME and MX answers cannot be reported from the library's parse.
